title: Settings of the width sweep (RB-093-01): Settings > Checks > Width sweep; rules on/off and severity in checks.rules

from.description: The first width a sweep sets, in CSS px.

to.description: The last width a sweep sets, in CSS px.

step.description: How far apart the widths of the first pass are, in CSS px; around every change the sweep then looks at each pixel.

kinds.description: What a sweep looks for: horizontal overflow of the page, text cut off by its box, visible neighbouring elements overlapping.

showSeconds.description: How long "Show at N px" on a width sweep finding holds the view at that width, in seconds; Escape or Cancel ends it sooner.
